# SBOM, THIRD-PARTY & License Verification Template
**Parent: ch.09 §11, ch.11 §10 · Generated by `scripts/sbom.sh`, verified by `scripts/license-check.sh`**

## 1. SBOM generation (three roots merged — one root is how blobs hide)

```bash
scripts/sbom.sh <sku> <ver>   # merges:
#  kernel: git SHA + .config + module list + out-of-tree ledger (TECH-DEBT.md state)
#  aosp: manifest.xml pinned SHAs + lunch target + vendor_module_list
#  debian: snapshot stamp + dpkg -l full list + packages.host diff vs snapshot
#  firmware: BLOB-SHA256.txt entries + redist flags + extraction source
# output: sbom/<sku>/SBOM-<ver>.spdx.json (SPDX 2.3, packages + files + relationships)
```

Firmware is the fourth root people forget — our script fails if `vendor/<sku>/BLOBS.md` has an entry missing from the SBOM (ch.02 §4 inventory is load-bearing here). Unknown-license component = build fail (ch.11 §10) with the component named (fix the metadata, don't bypass the check).

## 2. THIRD-PARTY & NOTICE (user-visible, in-image + release page)

Generated `THIRD-PARTY` (name+version+license+URL per component, grouped: kernel / AOSP / Debian / firmware) ships in-image (Settings → About → Legal, both stacks link the same file — one truth) + release page. `NOTICE` preserves Apache-2.0 attributions verbatim (AOSP requirement — automated check that NOTICE contains every `NOTICE`-file hash from synced repos).

## 3. license-check.sh gates (per MR + per release)

Per-MR (fast): new-file SPDX header scan (kernel `.c/.h` need `SPDX-License-Identifier`, our Go/Rust need header or `LICENSE` ref), `PRIVATE KEY` PEM scan (ch.08 §8), NOTICE-hash spot check. Per-release (slow): full SBOM regen + diff vs previous release (new/removed/upgraded components listed in release notes §SBOM — new blobs are news, ch.09 §11), `debsecan` + kernel-CVE + AOSP-bulletin dispositions attached (ch.08 §11), firmware-redist re-verification (a blob extract-only last release is re-checked — licenses change, ch.11 risk #6).

## 4. GPL compliance packet (same-day SLA, ch.11 §4)

Per release: kernel source tarball (exact SHA + `defconfig` + overlay set + toolchain versions + build command from ch.03 §11) published alongside images + written offer text in image (`/usr/share/doc/halide/SOURCE-OFFER.txt`) + scripts to rebuild (`build-all.sh` works from packet alone — tested annually by rebuilding a 6-month-old release from packet only; failure = process bug P1).

## Verification

- [ ] SBOM diff published; license gates green; GPL packet rebuild drill passes annually.
